text:
emma_finance: Heads-up — month-end revenue schedule mismatch for customer AURORA-1. Hosted usage shows $42,300 for April but our revenue schedule shows $0 deferred for their 3-month reserved capacity prepay. Looks like the prepaid commit was recognized in full instead of being deferred. Need guidance on the accrual/deferral adjustment and sign-off for a manual JE this close.

suresh_acct: Ack. Can you paste the invoice IDs and the original prepay amount? I need to check the rev schedule and the recognition analysis.

emma_finance: Invoice list pasted below (pulled from billing export):
```
INV-2024-0587, amount: 120000, invoice_date: 2024-04-02, product: Dedicated Reserved Capacity
INV-2024-0588, amount: 30000, invoice_date: 2024-04-02, product: Support addon
```
Only INV-2024-0587 should have been deferred across 12 months (monthly revenue 10k). But the system posted 120k to revenue on 2024-04-02.

jordan_revops: That explains the revenue spike in April vs forecast. Proposal: reverse the 120k recognized in Apr (credit revenue, debit AR/cash adjustment) and post a deferred revenue liability of 120k, then amortize 10k/mo starting May.

emma_finance: Draft JE I had in mind: 
```
Date: 2024-04-30 (close)
Dr: Revenue (recognition) 120,000
Cr: Deferred Revenue 120,000
Narrative: Reverse improper recognition of reserved capacity prepay per contract AURORA-1
```
This will move April impact to Deferred Rev. Then we can post monthly amortization beginning May.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0587 status: paid. Payment date: 2024-04-05. Related customer: AURORA-1. Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2024-0587 :white_check_mark:

suresh_acct: OK. Need source of truth for the contract term and start date — if contract started 2024-04-02 and term is 12 months, amortization from Apr not May. Also need PO or order confirmation to confirm revenue start.

maya_sales: FYI customer countersigned SOW on 2024-03-28, term start 2024-04-01 per clause 2.1. Sales noted they wanted revenue to begin on 4/1 but finance routing said defer. Customer hasn't disputed invoice.

jordan_revops: If contractexplicitly starts 4/1 then revenue should start recognizing 4/1 (so amortization from April). But because system already recognized full amount on 4/2, we should: 1) reverse the full recognition in April close, 2) post deferred revenue, 3) post pro-rated amortization for April (one month amount) OR include April in amort schedule depending on when we run monthly amort.

emma_finance: Good catch. So updated draft JE for close (to both correct and record April amort):
```
1) Closing correction (posted 2024-04-30):
Dr: Revenue 120,000
Cr: Deferred Revenue 120,000
2) Record April amortization (if we include Apr):
Dr: Deferred Revenue 10,000
Cr: Revenue 10,000
Net April impact after JEs: -110,000 to revenue (i.e., corrects the over-recognition)
```

suresh_acct: I can review and post. Please attach supporting docs in the GL close folder: invoice PDF, signed SOW, billing export CSV, and a short memo. Also confirm the GL accounts to use: Rev account 4001, Deferred Rev 2305.

emma_finance: Uploading docs to Close/2024-04/AURORA-1 now and tagging you. Also including the billing export slice and our amort schedule.

maya_sales: Customer PO is PO-90877, attached. They asked for billing to be net 0 for support add-on this quarter, unrelated. No dispute on the reserved capacity.

jordan_revops: From ops standpoint, we should also add a permanent guardrail: ensure reserved capacity invoices set a deferral flag at invoice creation. I'll open a ticket with Billing to add validation. @billing-bot can you create a ticket?

billing-bot: Created ticket #BILL-4132: "reserved_capacity: default deferral flag for prepay invoices" assigned to billing-team. Link: https://issues.internal/BILL-4132

emma_finance: Thanks. Next steps: Suresh to review & post JE, Emma to file memo and update revenue schedule, Jordan to track billing ticket. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you approve the JE to post.

suresh_acct: :white_check_mark: I'll post by EOD and add comment with JE batch number.

emma_finance: :thumbsup: Closing loop here. Will confirm once JE posted and P&L updated.
